daily.today_energy: The Moon in Aries is pushing you to move faster than usual, while Saturn retrograde reminds you that slowing down has its perks. Find the middle ground—you don't have to choose between stability and action today.
daily.love: Venus in Libra is creating smooth vibes for connections, but Mercury in Scorpio wants deeper talks. If you're coupled up, now's the time for real conversations that actually matter. Single? Authenticity is magnetic.
daily.career: Mars and Jupiter conjunction is amplifying ambition across the board, but that Sun square hitting them both means overconfidence could slip in. Trust your solid Taurus instincts—you don't need to prove anything to anyone.
daily.health: Your body might feel restless with all this fire energy floating around. Channel it into movement you actually enjoy rather than forcing intensity. A walk, yoga, or stretching will help you feel grounded.

weekly.overview: This week hits different for you, Taurus. The Moon swings into your sign midweek, amplifying your magnetism right when Venus sextiles Jupiter—expect serious charisma. Early week feels tense thanks to Sun Square Mars, but by Friday when the Full Moon arrives, you're in your power. Best Day: Thursday. Watch-Out Day: Monday's friction needs patience.
weekly.love: Monday-Tuesday feels emotionally choppy, but don't overthink it. Midweek, the Moon in Taurus makes you irresistible—your vibe speaks louder than words. If you're single, someone notices. If coupled, intimacy deepens naturally. Venus sextile Jupiter amplifies attraction all week, so lean into it. By weekend, the Full Moon softens any lingering tension.
weekly.career: Early week brings competitive energy that tests your resolve—Sun Square Mars wants you to prove yourself, but rushing backfires. Play it strategic. Midweek shifts the momentum: your ideas land better, people listen harder, and that presentation or pitch has real weight. The Mars-Jupiter conjunction fuels ambition without the aggression. Close out strong.
weekly.health: Monday's tense aspects might trigger tension headaches or restlessness—move your body, don't sit with it. Midweek, energy rebounds as the Moon enters Taurus, grounding you. The Full Moon Thursday amplifies everything, so sleep matters. Push workouts early in the week; ease up by Friday. Hydrate consistently; stress peaks early but dissolves fast.
